correctness.rationale: The complete atomic diagrams include equality, both arc directions and self-loops. At each additional rank, equality of the sets of extension types is exactly the two-sided one-point back-and-forth condition; multiplicities play no role, and finite characteristic formulas witness different types. Rotation makes anchoring the first point at zero sound. Independent replay: python -B /workspace/review_replay.py 4 computes the five partitions for n=1–32 and matches the stored certificate (4,403 types), using occupied points and directed-gap endpoint classes for the final move instead of enumerating every final placement. The infinite tail does not rely on extrapolation: after the first of q moves, both full gaps are at least 2^q for n,m≥2^q. With r moves left, preserving short gaps exactly and pairing gaps at least 2^(r+1) lets Duplicator match a short side of the next split or choose two sides at least 2^r. At r=0 this preserves all unit directed gaps and equality; any cycle in the tail has no loop, and repeated vertex selections are matched. The rank-five finite partition bridges 19 to 32; lower-rank equivalences follow by transitivity and rank monotonicity. The result is confined to a single cycle in the relational language.
